question: Was Harry Kane Bayern Munich's most valuable player in his debut 2023-24 Bundesliga season?

scout_notes.author: The Athletic — Honigstein
scout_notes.summary: Record-breaking individual season but Bayern lost the title to Leverkusen by 18 points. Tuchel's structural problems were not solved by elite striker output.

dossier.context_notes: Bayern finished 2nd, 18 points behind Leverkusen, ending an 11-year Bundesliga title streak. Kane won the Bundesliga top scorer (36). On/off splits not reliably available in public Bundesliga data.

__uncertaintyNote__: Uncertain framing. Kane's individual case (36 goals, 49% goal-involvement share) is overwhelming, BUT the framework's 'valuable' prong asks about team success and Bayern lost the title — a YES with high confidence sits in tension with the team outcome. Dossier lacks on/off splits (Bundesliga public data poorer). User should decide whether 'most valuable' is per-player-output or per-team-outcome under this framework.
